channel.title: healthbook TIMES Oncology Hematology - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from healthbook TIMES Oncology Hematology (onco-hema.healthbooktimes.org)

item.title: Recent Advances in Radioligand Therapy | Published in healthbook TIMES Oncology Hematology
item.description: By Irene A. Burger. This review summarizes the key recent updates in RLT, highlighting the major clinical advances in prostate cancer and gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NETs).

item.title: CAR T-Cell Therapy for Richter’s Syndrome and Central Nervous System PTLD After Solid Organ Transplantation: Two Case Reports | Published in healthbook TIMES Oncology Hematology
item.description: By Daniela Weiler, Annaïse Jauch & 3 more. CAR T-cell therapy produced rapid, durable complete remissions in two high-risk, refractory DLBCL cases—Richter’s transformation and CNS-involved PTLD—suggesting broader utility in rare presentations often excluded from trials.

item.title: Neurokinin 1/3 Receptor Antagonists for Vasomotor Symptoms in Women with Breast Cancer | Published in healthbook TIMES Oncology Hematology
item.description: By Michael Gnant, Marcus Vetter & 1 more. This review highlights the rationale, evidence and clinical potential of neurokinin receptor antagonists as emerging non-hormonal options for managing breast cancer-related VMS.

item.title: Evolving Approaches for the Treatment of Muscle-Invasive Bladder Cancer | Published in healthbook TIMES Oncology Hematology
item.description: By Ursula Vogl. This editorial by PD (AUT) Dr Ursula Vogl discusses the evolving approaches in the treatment of muslce-invasive bladder cancer

item.title: PARP Inhibition as an Effective Therapeutic Strategy in Disseminated TNBC with Extensive CNS Metastases: A Case Report | Published in healthbook TIMES Oncology Hematology
item.description: By Tim Kahl, David Matt & 1 more. This case highlights the importance of comprehensive molecular testing and flexible treatment sequencing in patients with advanced TNBC.

item.title: The Emerging Role of Oral SERDs in Early Breast Cancer | Published in healthbook TIMES Oncology Hematology
item.description: By Marcus Vetter. This editorial from Prof. Dr Marcus Vetter discusses the role of oral SERD

item.title: Bridge the Gap to CAR: Bridging Therapy in CAR T-Cell Therapy for Relapsed or Refractory Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma | Published in healthbook TIMES Oncology Hematology
item.description: By Andreas Holbro, Marc Wehrli. This review discusses the current scientific understanding of bridging therapy in the context of CAR T-cell treatment for R/R DLBCL, including its rationale, approaches, clinical evidence and future prospects.

item.title: Antibody-Drug Conjugate Sequencing in Metastatic Breast Cancer | Published in healthbook TIMES Oncology Hematology
item.description: By Benjamin Müller, Marcus Vetter. Collectively, these studies support the development of an individualized framework for ADC sequencing in metastatic breast cancer, bridging the current clinical practice with the emerging precision oncology paradigm.

item.title: High-Dose Chemotherapy and Stem Cell Transplantation in ZBTB16::RARA Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia: A Case Report | Published in healthbook TIMES Oncology Hematology
item.description: By Stefani Parmentier, German Ott & 3 more. We report a patient with ZBTB16::RARA APL who achieved durable molecular complete remission lasting over two years after high-dose chemotherapy with busulfan and cyclophosphamide followed by ASCT.

item.title: Hormone Replacement Therapy After Endometrial Cancer: Current Evidence and Treatment Recommendations | Published in healthbook TIMES Oncology Hematology
item.description: By Ursula Gobrecht-Keller, Marcus Vetter. This review synthesizes the current evidence, evaluates risk stratification models and offers a practical, patient-centered approach to the use of HRT in endometrial cancer survivors.
